mapper.update: UPDATE payment_attempt SET status = #{next}, response_summary = #{responseSummary}, failure_code = #{failureCode}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, version = version + 1, query_lock_owner = CASE WHEN #{next} = 'PROCESSING' THEN query_lock_owner ELSE NULL END, query_lock_until = CASE WHEN #{next} = 'PROCESSING' THEN query_lock_until ELSE NULL END, query_claim_token = CASE WHEN #{next} = 'PROCESSING' THEN query_claim_token ELSE NULL END WHERE attempt_id = #{attemptId} AND status = #{expected} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
